messages.subject: Sequenza question about segment.filter
messages.body_plain:
Hi Francesco,

I am confused about the segment.filter parameter, Sequenza manual describe it: threshold segment length (in base pairs) to filter out short segments, that can cause noise when fitting the cellularity and ploidy parameters. The threshold will not affect the allele-specific segmentation. When I use sequenza, I set segment.filter=5e6, but I got segments that are less than 5e6. So the parameter will not affect output segments? How can I filter output short segments?

The attachment is mt output segments, I think there are many short segments.
